description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kaluwarippuwa West, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511235 (25/120009)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to ownership or possession of land parcels in various villages in Gampaha District. It involves land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, cadastral maps, and determination of land ownership - all falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and land settlement matters.
